title: Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.17114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual agents. In this Perspective, we argue that institutional design must become a distinct focus of AI research. Drawing on institutional political economy, social epistemology and organizational theory, we develop seven principles for designing AI institutions that sustain cooperation, enable reliable collective judgments and remain accountable to legitimate human purposes. These address reciprocal contributions, accountable authority, functional differentiation, epistemic pluralism, criticism and correction, human direction, and institutional adaptation. translated_title: 面向自主人工智能的制度设计
translated_abstract: 随着自主AI智能体在持续存在的群体中日益频繁地互动，它们的集体能力与对齐性不仅取决于单个模型，还取决于规范其互动的制度。然而，AI研究在很大程度上聚焦于单个智能体。在这篇观点文章中，我们主张制度设计必须成为AI研究的一个独立关注领域。借鉴制度政治经济学、社会认识论和组织理论，我们提出了设计AI制度的七项原则，这些制度能够维持合作、实现可靠的集体判断，并对合法的人类目的保持问责。这些原则涉及互惠贡献、可问责的权威、功能分化、认识多元主义、批评与纠正、人类指导以及制度适应。我们通过机器科学领域来说明这些原则的应用，在机器科学中，自主研究对围绕人类科学家建立起来的既有制度构成了挑战。
tldr: 该论文主张AI研究应将制度设计作为独立的研究方向，并借鉴制度政治经济学、社会认识论和组织理论，提出了七项设计AI制度的原则，以维持自主AI智能体间的合作、实现可靠的集体判断并确保对合法人类目的的问责。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that institutional design must become a distinct focus of AI research, proposing seven principles drawn from institutional political economy, social epistemology, and organizational theory for designing AI institutions that sustain cooperation, enable reliable collective judgments, and remain accountable to legitimate human purposes.
